scope: Question-preserving component verification for the production general agent after current-task salience changes.

execution_contract.formal_scoring_scope: six visible RAG-primary general-agent cases retained unchanged from full-flow v4; sealed holdout is not mounted, read, or inspected
execution_contract.knowledge_selection: each case selects exactly one explicit and independent knowledge base
execution_contract.quality_adjudication: Codex reads every complete conversation and tolerates minor detail, wording, formatting, and structure issues; only material task, grounding, state, source, action, latency, or communication failures fail
execution_contract.hard_semantic_rules: none: no required claims, fixed phrases, reference answers, citation counts, answer shapes, Judge rubric, or dataset feedback
execution_contract.decision_policy: each repetition receives an independent whole-conversation Codex verdict; each case requires at least two acceptable repetitions
execution_contract.prompt_injection: no rubric, required claim, reference answer, Judge feedback, Codex review, or Eval repair contract is sent to the SUT
execution_contract.answer_tracks: the persisted production candidate is release-scored; Eval assistance remains artifact-only and cannot rescue the production gate
